biography.value: Shadow Lords reshape engagements through darkness rather than through direct force. Darkness Domain creates permanent darkness across a 60-foot diameter, immediately giving the Shadow Lord and any Shadow creatures present a massive advantage against opponents who cannot see in magical darkness. Shadow Army calls additional Shadow creatures under the Shadow Lord's direction, not the summoner's — which is a useful addition to the fight or a complication depending on whether instructions to the Shadow Lord are precise. Life Drain Aura at 20 feet erodes maximum HP at 4 per round from everything nearby. Planar Step at-will makes positioning it very difficult — it is always exactly where it chooses to be. A summoner who deploys one in an environment with any natural darkness and gives it clear instructions will find it turns the entire encounter into a fight that happens on its terms rather than the enemy's.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Devil's Sight, See Invisibility, Perfect sight 60 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Shadow Rend [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 Negative damage (Ignore DR); target loses 5 from Current Luck; max HP reduced by 12 until long rest.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 6; max HP reduced by 18; Weakened + Sickened + Disoriented for 1 minute; no save.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage; all conditions; max HP reduced by 24; target makes Fortitude [Hard] save or gains 1 Exhaustion level and loses 1 point of Constitution permanently until Major Restoration.

Void Lance [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 Negative damage (15 + 3 Dex); Current Luck reduced by 4; max HP reduced by 8.
  • Margin 2: 18 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 6; max HP reduced by 14; Weakened + Sickened for 1 minute; no save.
  • Margin 3: 18 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); all conditions; max HP reduced by 20; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Shadow Form: While in dim light or darkness, DR increases to 12 against all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. Positive energy ignores this entirely. Life Drain Aura: Creatures within 20 feet that are not Shadow creatures lose 4 from their maximum HP at the start of each of their turns. This maximum HP loss persists until long rest. A creature reduced to 0 maximum HP by this aura dies. Darkness Domain (1/encounter) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, creates permanent magical darkness in a 60-foot diameter centered on itself. Permanent until dispelled by the Shadow Lord's dismissal. The Shadow Lord and Shadow creatures see through it normally. Shadow Army (1/day): As a [Combat] action, the Shadow Lord calls 2 Shade Walkers from the Shadow Plane. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet and act on the Shadow Lord's initiative, following its direction. They are not under the summoner's control. Duration: 1 hour or until dismissed. Planar Step (at-will): The Shadow Lord steps between shadows freely, teleporting up to 30 feet to any dim or dark location it can see as a [Move] action. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Shadow Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
